Landing.heroTitle: Find the ideal startup for your company
Landing.heroDescription: Describe your challenge and our AI agents will find the best startups for your company.
Landing.howItWorksTitle: Artificial intelligence at the service of your growth
Landing.howItWorksDescription: Our agent pipeline works together to find and evaluate startups that solve your challenge.
Landing.aiAnalysisDescription: Specialized agents conduct a natural conversation to deeply understand your business challenge, generating a detailed product document.
Landing.precisionMatchingDescription: We cross-reference 50+ dimensions — sector, technology, stage, business model, location — to find startups that truly fit.
Landing.realtimePipelineDescription: Follow the entire process live: from the initial conversation to the final results, with full transparency into the agents' reasoning.
Landing.pipelineDescription: Each stage uses a specialized Claude model. You follow everything in real-time in the side panel.
Landing.step01Description: Chat naturally with our Navigator agent. It understands your context, problem and goals without rigid forms.
Landing.step02Description: The BizDev agent analyzes the entire conversation and produces a structured product document with your mapped needs.
Landing.step03Description: The Scout agent searches our startup database, evaluates each candidate and returns the best matches with justifications.
Landing.ctaDescription: Start a conversation and let our agents work for you. No forms, no waiting.
Landing.footerDescription: AI-powered corporate-startup matching platform. Describe your challenge and our agents will find the best startups.
